item.title: Decent Espresso · Bengle's upcoming infrared milk probe
item.description:
Decent Espresso (2026-09-21)
Tthe infrared milk sensor that will fit on Bengle can read the temperature of the milk without being immersed in it. Steam can auto-stop at the temperature you want, there's very little cleanup, and the steam wand remains pro and easy to move, unlike steam wands that embed a temperature probe in the wand itself.
